title: Finite A1 Galerkin QFT candidate: linear heat and Gaussian current ledger
purpose: Derive and audit the finite-dimensional Gaussian/OU interface obtained from the hash-pinned A1 quadratic kernel. The package gives a conditional output-heat current ledger with the actual embedded Pauli generators; it does not identify the nonlinear A13 production dynamics.

registered_inputs.output_heat_integral: integral_0^infinity 2 exp(-2 K_r t) dt = K_r^(-1)
registered_inputs.tail_profile: K_n^(-1)=O(<n>^-4), convolution O(<r>^-4), q_r=O(<r>^-6) in d=3
registered_inputs.scope: complex finite Galerkin field with independent proper complex Gaussian Fourier roots; output heat uses the scalar lower rate K_r

hostile_mutations: replace r,Z,Y by an unrelated kernel
replace the three embedded generators by one generator
omit the coherent convolution sum over p
replace output heat K_r by an external kinetic coefficient
claim the finite ledger is the nonlinear production q-ledger
insert Lean sorry, admit, axiom or unsafe escape
boundary: This is a T0 claim-nonbearing finite Gaussian/OU candidate interface. It proves a conditional linearized A1 output-heat current ledger and its d=3 tail screen. It does not identify the nonlinear A1 Gibbs dynamics, conditional root filtration, production heat_root_incidence, raw-current spatial intertwiner, feedback/revisit owner, forest/source/sextic one-use, A13/T-050, interacting measure, physical-empty comparison, removal, continuum, real-time, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
next_action: Use the derived linear candidate only as a comparison owner. To advance R-192, hash-pin the nonlinear A1 heat/root generator and conditional replicas, then rerun the unchanged owner order with the same coherent output ledger and all feedback, forest, low, source and sextic slots explicit.
